# CodeHunter Lab

> AI automation consultancy and software development studio based in Leiden, Netherlands.
> We build autonomous AI systems, custom web applications, and workflow automation for growing businesses.

## About

CodeHunter Lab is a technical consultancy specializing in:
- AI agent development (WhatsApp bots, voice agents, sales automation)
- Workflow automation with n8n (migrating from Zapier/Make)
- Custom software development (React, Next.js, TypeScript)
- IT system integration (APIs, CRMs, ERPs)
- Custom internal tools and admin dashboards
- LLM fine-tuning and private AI deployments

Based in Leiden, Zuid-Holland. Serving clients across the Netherlands and internationally.
